verdict.rationale: Choosing a data storage region is a fair question for a SaaS automation platform like Make, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions regions, residency, or data location choices. Data stores (make-docs-29) and on-prem agents (make-docs-39) are related features, not region or residency selection, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
